# One Call to the Model {#sec-one-call}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "AI is magic" — it is one function call over HTTP.

Installs: `get_response`; the reading habit of asking what a tool adds
to the plain call. Working build: a five-line script that answers a
question, then the same call with the curtain pulled back (the request
payload, printed).
:::
